<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Bugfix: `set_active_mm_loras` builds tower/connector LoRA mapping rows for encoder-cache-served mm items that the encoder forward skips, shifting every later item's rows onto the wrong adapter. Rebased onto current main after #42662 rewrote the mapping loop; the bug carries over unchanged.

## Claims

- Cache-served items (`mm_feature.data is None`) are skipped by `EncoderRunner.prepare_mm_inputs` (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/mm/encoder_runner.py:90`) in the encoder forward, but `set_active_mm_loras` (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/mm/lora.py`) still counted them into the TOWER/CONNECTOR `LoRAMapping`s. Punica consumes the mapping positionally, so one cached item misroutes every subsequent item's rows onto the wrong LoRA — silent output corruption, and a size mismatch against the actual encoder batch M.
- Fix mirrors the exact skip when building `mm_items` (one filtered comprehension). If every scheduled item is cache-served, the existing empty-mapping early return leaves adapters untouched, matching a forward that runs nothing.

## Validation

Re-run on an A100 after rebasing onto current main (nightly `vllm 0.31.1rc1.dev376+g5555a2d8f`, `torch 2.13.0+cu129`), with the module patched by this diff:

```
$ python -m pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py -q -k set_active_mm_loras
3 passed, 51 deselected in 2.29s
```

RED check — the new test against the unpatched module fails as expected:

```
FAILED tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py::test_set_active_mm_loras_skips_items_without_data
1 failed, 53 deselected in 1.72s
```

Lint: `ruff format --check` / `ruff check` (pinned v0.14.0) pass on both changed files.

## Details

- Updated the two pre-existing `set_active_mm_loras` tests to carry sentinel `data=Mock()` (with the fix, all-`None` fixtures would be skipped entirely); every existing assertion is unchanged. Added `test_set_active_mm_loras_skips_items_without_data`: a present item mixed with a cache-served one contributes exactly its own rows, and an all-cache-served step sets nothing.
- Not a duplicate: no open PR touches this path (`gh pr list --state open --search "set_active_mm_loras"`). #42662 (merged) migrated the token-count interface in this file; this fix is orthogonal and is now expressed on top of it.
- Known related gap, deliberately out of scope: `prepare_mm_inputs` has two more skip paths (an item whose identifier is already in `encoder_cache.encoder_outputs` within the same step, and `prompt_embeds` passthrough items) that also still receive mapping rows. Same bug class; happy to follow up once this lands if maintainers agree.
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used. I reviewed every changed line; the test commands and results above are from my own runs.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

-                data=None,
+                data=Mock(),
                 modality=modality,
                 identifier=f"{req_id}-0",

@@ -661,6 +661,82 @@ def test_set_active_mm_loras_follows_modality_sorted_encoder_order():
     assert tower_mapping.index_mapping == (0, 0, 7)
 
 
+def test_set_active_mm_loras_skips_items_without_data():
+    """Cache-served items (data=None) are skipped by
+    EncoderRunner.prepare_mm_inputs, so they must not add mapping rows."""
+    model = Mock()
+    model.get_mm_lora_token_counts.side_effect = (
+        lambda *, modality, mm_kwargs, num_mm_embeds: (
+            num_mm_embeds + 1,
+            num_mm_embeds + 11,
+        )
+    )
+    model.get_mm_mapping.return_value = SimpleNamespace(connector=True)
+
+    lora_manager = Mock()
+    lora_manager.supports_tower_connector_lora.return_value = True
+
+    encoder_cache = EncoderCache()
+    encoder_cache.mm_features["req-with-lora"] = [
+        MultiModalFeatureSpec(
+            data=Mock(),
+            modality="image",
+            identifier="img-0",
+            mm_position=PlaceholderRange(offset=0, length=2),
+        ),
+        MultiModalFeatureSpec(
+            data=None,
+            modality="image",
+            identifier="img-1",
+            mm_position=PlaceholderRange(offset=2, length=3),
+        ),
+    ]
+
+    lora_state = LoraState(max_num_reqs=4)
+    lora_request = LoRARequest("vision-lora", 7, "/tmp/vision-lora")
+    lora_state.add_request("req-with-lora", 0, lora_request)
+
+    set_active_mm_loras(
+        model=model,
+        lora_manager=lora_manager,
+        encoder_cache=encoder_cache,
+        req_id_to_index={"req-with-lora": 0},
+        lora_state=lora_state,
+        scheduled_encoder_inputs={"req-with-lora": [0, 1]},
+    )
+
+    # Only img-0 (data present) contributes rows: 2 embeds -> 3 tower and
+    # 13 connector tokens. The cache-served img-1 adds nothing, matching
+    # EncoderRunner.prepare_mm_inputs.
+    assert lora_manager.set_active_adapters.call_count == 2
+    _, tower_mapping = lora_manager.set_active_adapters.call_args_list[0].args
+    assert tower_mapping.type is LoRAMappingType.TOWER
+    assert tower_mapping.prompt_mapping == (7,)
+    assert tower_mapping.index_mapping == (7, 7, 7)
+    _, connector_mapping = lora_manager.set_active_adapters.call_args_list[1].args
+    assert connector_mapping.type is LoRAMappingType.CONNECTOR
+    assert connector_mapping.prompt_mapping == (7,)
+    assert connector_mapping.index_mapping == (7,) * 13
+
+    # A step where every scheduled item is cache-served maps nothing.
+    lora_manager.reset_mock()
+    encoder_cache.mm_features["req-with-lora"][0] = MultiModalFeatureSpec(
+        data=None,
+        modality="image",
+        identifier="img-0",
+        mm_position=PlaceholderRange(offset=0, length=2),
+    )
+    set_active_mm_loras(
+        model=model,
+        lora_manager=lora_manager,
+        encoder_cache=encoder_cache,
+        req_id_to_index={"req-with-lora": 0},
+        lora_state=lora_state,
+        scheduled_encoder_inputs={"req-with-lora": [0, 1]},
+    )
+    lora_manager.set_active_adapters.assert_not_called()
+
+
 def test_batch_mm_inputs_from_scheduler_sorts_by_modality():
     features = {
         f"req{i}": MultiModalFeatureSpec(

@@ -40,7 +40,14 @@ def set_active_mm_loras(
 
         lora_id = int(lora_state.lora_ids[req_idx])
         mm_features = encoder_cache.mm_features[req_id]
-        mm_items.extend((lora_id, mm_features[i]) for i in encoder_input_ids)
+        # Cache-served items (data=None) are skipped by
+        # EncoderRunner.prepare_mm_inputs, so they must not contribute mapping
+        # rows, or every later item's rows shift onto the wrong LoRA.
+        mm_items.extend(
+            (lora_id, mm_features[i])
+            for i in encoder_input_ids
+            if mm_features[i].data is not None
+        )
 
         if lora_id > 0:
             lora_request = lora_state.lora_requests.get(req_id)
